tasks.title: Create @taxkit/effect-mdx with the format Schemas, errors and contracts
tasks.goal: Give the authored format one domain-free owner without changing any output.
scope: Before editing, build the catalogue at the base commit and save a copy in the scratchpad as the baseline.
Create packages/effect-mdx (private, compiled) with ./schemas, ./errors and ./service.

Move the block, inline, token, diagram, heading id and href Schemas out of packages/content/src/schemas.ts as Mdx* names, with effect-mdx/* brands; make MdxCodeLanguage a bounded identifier instead of a fixed list.
Add the MdxDocument(frontmatter) and MdxCollection(frontmatter) Schema constructors and MdxFrontmatterBase.
Point content, web, mcp and publication imports at @taxkit/effect-mdx/schemas.
Add packages/effect-mdx to domainFreeOwners and its ./schemas, ./errors and ./service exports to frontendModules in tools/oxlint/package-roles.ts.
outputs: Updated imports and the lint role lists
mandatoryVerification: Catalogue byte gate and OpenAPI gate
qualityAudits: No Schema is defined twice; content keeps no copy of a block Schema.

Split link resolution: generic rules in effect-mdx, and MdxFileLinks for other relative links; add MdxFileLinksNone (./links) and DocsRepositoryFileLinksLive (content).
Move the highlighter to ./highlights and the Mermaid renderer to ./mermaid; add MdxDiagramTheme and supply the Website palette from content.
Move readingMarkdown to ./markdown as toMarkdown.
Add ./test adapters: MdxCodeHighlighterTest, MdxDiagramRendererTest, MdxFileLinksTest.
Add the content ./build export with DocsCatalogueBuildLive; use it in apps/api/scripts/docs-catalogue.layer.ts (then delete that file), apps/web/scripts/docs-images.build.ts and apps/api/test.
Delete packages/mdx, packages/diagrams and DocsPageReader, DocsSources, DocsCodeHighlighter and DocsDiagramRenderer; update knip, oxlint.config.ts, portable-rules.test.ts and manifests.
